idea-plugin.name: Jenkinsfile Free
idea-plugin.description:
Free Jenkinsfile editor for GoLand and IntelliJ-based IDEs.

Recognizes any filename containing jenkinsfile, regardless of letter case or file extension.

Includes Groovy and Jenkins Pipeline syntax highlighting, embedded shell, Windows batch, and PowerShell highlighting in sh, bat/cmd, powershell, and pwsh script literals, grammar checks, context-aware completion, named-field highlighting, an outline in the Structure view, Jenkins GDSL import, and idempotent formatting.

Formats with Ctrl+Shift+L (or the IDE Reformat Code action). Normalizes whitespace, separates Pipeline sections, and formats long named arguments one field per line. Safe POSIX sh literals are split into readable multiline scripts; existing multiline shell is formatted in place. Ambiguous shell constructs are left unchanged. Repeated formatting produces the same result.

The plugin works offline and does not collect or upload source code. Source and license: GitHub.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Format safe POSIX sh literals as readable multiline shell, including one option per line for long commands; format existing multiline shell in place.
  • Keep heredocs, shell control-flow, shebangs, and ambiguous string expressions unchanged.
  • Highlight common POSIX shell syntax in sh, Windows batch syntax in bat/cmd, and PowerShell syntax in powershell/pwsh script literals.
  • Fix whitespace handling in the platform formatter, preventing repeated formatting from accumulating spaces and blank lines.
  • Use consistent block indentation and compact statement spacing, with a single blank line between Pipeline sections and stages.
  • Format calls with three or more named fields, and long argument lists, one argument per line.
  • Retain case-insensitive filename detection and named-field highlighting.
